name: io.github.vmware-skills/vmware-monitor
title: VMware Monitor
description: Read-only VMware vCenter/ESXi monitoring with 31 MCP tools. No destructive code paths; every vSphere call is allowlist-gated in the test suite.

packageArguments.description: Starts the stdio MCP server. Without it the console script runs the human CLI and exits.

environmentVariables.name: VMWARE_MONITOR_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the config file. Defaults to ~/.vmware-monitor/config.yaml.
